headline: Sunday recovery jog: undershot on time and effort, and that's fine
summary:
Prescribed was 60min steady at 135-145bpm; actual was 55min moving (3026s) at 113bpm average, well below target band — this landed as a genuine shakeout, not the planned aerobic dose. RPE 3, feel great (1/5), zero pain flagged, cadence data not captured. Given yesterday's Presolana long run (137 load, 853m D+, 8118s) plus Saturday's 5h3m hike stacked on top, the lighter-than-prescribed HR is the legs (and good sense) talking, not a missed session — compliance on paper looks low but the intent (easy volume on tired legs after the Wk2 weekend pattern) was served. RHR ticked to 51 this morning (vs 45-47 all week) and HRV settled to 55 after a 64-79 run — first signs of the weekend load registering, worth watching into Tuesday's Wk3 threshold day.</summary>
